blocks.zh: 沙門氏菌、綠膿桿菌、金黃色葡萄球菌、梭菌與白色念珠菌測試
blocks.en: Tests for Salmonella, Pseudomonas aeruginosa, Staphylococcus aureus, Clostridia and Candida albicans

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握 Salmonella 測試的特殊要求：10 g 最低檢測量、Rappaport Vassiliadis 增菌、XLD 平板上的紅色/黑心菌落特徵
blocks.en: Master the special requirements of the Salmonella test: the 10 g minimum test quantity, Rappaport Vassiliadis enrichment, and the red/black-centered colony appearance on XLD agar

blocks.zh: 理解 P. aeruginosa 測試的選擇性培養基（Cetrimide Agar）原理與經皮貼片的特殊處理
blocks.en: Understand the principle of the selective medium (Cetrimide Agar) in the P. aeruginosa test and the special handling of transdermal patches

blocks.zh: 掌握 S. aureus 測試中 Mannitol Salt Agar 的高鹽選擇性與黃色環指示反應
blocks.en: Master the high-salt selectivity of Mannitol Salt Agar and the yellow-zone indicator reaction in the S. aureus test

blocks.zh: 理解 Clostridia 測試的獨特設計：熱處理分樣、厭氧培養、催化酶陰性確認
blocks.en: Understand the distinctive design of the Clostridia test: heat-treated split sample, anaerobic incubation, and confirmation by negative catalase

blocks.zh: 掌握 C. albicans 測試的長培養時間（3-5 天）與真菌檢測的特殊考量
blocks.en: Master the long incubation time (3-5 days) of the C. albicans test and the special considerations in fungal detection

blocks.zh: 整合所有 USP ⟨62⟩ 測試的流程圖，建立系統性的測試規劃能力
blocks.en: Integrate the flowcharts of all USP ⟨62⟩ tests to build the ability to plan testing systematically

blocks.zh: 2.1 Salmonella — 沙門氏菌測試
blocks.en: 2.1 Salmonella Test

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Salmonella 測試的三大特殊之處：
blocks.en: Three special features of the Salmonella test:

blocks.zh: 最低檢測量 10 g（非 1 g）：這是所有 ⟨62⟩ 測試中最大的樣品量要求。為什麼？因為 Salmonella 在藥品中的汙染濃度通常極低，使用更多樣品才能提高檢出率。這也反映了 Salmonella 汙染的嚴重性 — 對患者的健康風險極高。
blocks.en: Minimum test quantity of 10 g (not 1 g): This is the largest sample quantity required among all ⟨62⟩ tests. Why? Salmonella contamination in drug products is usually at very low levels, so a larger sample is needed to improve the detection rate. It also reflects the seriousness of Salmonella contamination, which poses a very high health risk to patients.

blocks.zh: Rappaport Vassiliadis（RV）增菌培養基：這是微生物學中最精巧的選擇性培養基之一。它含有孔雀石綠（Malachite Green）和高濃度的 MgCl2，創造出一個極端選擇性的環境。pH 低至 5.2，使大多數腸道菌無法生長，但 Salmonella 適應力強而存活。
blocks.en: Rappaport Vassiliadis (RV) enrichment broth: This is one of the most elegant selective media in microbiology. It contains malachite green and a high concentration of MgCl2, creating an extremely selective environment. The pH is as low as 5.2, which prevents most enteric bacteria from growing, while Salmonella is resilient enough to survive.

blocks.zh: XLD 平板的指示反應：Salmonella 在 XLD Agar 上的典型菌落是紅色的（因為不發酵木糖後的 pH 變化）。如果 Salmonella 產生 H2S，菌落中心會出現黑色沉澱（硫化鐵）。
blocks.en: Indicator reaction on XLD plates: Typical Salmonella colonies on XLD Agar are red (because of the pH change that follows non-fermentation of xylose). If the Salmonella produces H2S, a black precipitate (ferrous sulfide) appears in the center of the colony.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 深海特殊生物的捕撈：
blocks.en: Fishing for a rare deep-sea creature:

blocks.zh: Salmonella 就像深海中的稀有魚類 — 你需要用更大的漁網（10 g 樣品而非 1 g）、更特殊的誘餌（RV 增菌培養基的極端環境），才能把牠引出來。普通的漁具（一般增菌培養基）對付常見的魚（一般細菌）夠用，但要抓這種稀有又狡猾的魚，就需要專門的「釣法」。而 XLD 平板則像水族館的展示箱 — 讓你一眼就能從紅色身體和黑色斑點認出目標。
blocks.en: Salmonella is like a rare fish in the deep sea. You need a bigger net (a 10 g sample instead of 1 g) and a more specialized bait (the extreme environment of RV enrichment broth) to lure it out. Ordinary fishing gear (general enrichment media) is fine for common fish (common bacteria), but catching this rare and cunning fish takes a dedicated "fishing method". The XLD plate is then like an aquarium display tank: you can pick out the target at a glance by its red body and black spot.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: RV 培養基的滅菌溫度限制：Rappaport Vassiliadis Broth 的滅菌溫度不超過 115°C（而非常規的 121°C）。這是因為孔雀石綠在高溫下會降解，失去選擇性。實驗室常見錯誤是按照一般培養基程序滅菌，導致培養基失效。
blocks.en: Sterilization temperature limit for RV medium: Rappaport Vassiliadis Broth must not be sterilized above 115°C (not the usual 121°C), because malachite green degrades at high temperature and the medium loses its selectivity. A common laboratory error is to sterilize it with the standard medium cycle, which renders the medium ineffective.

blocks.zh: Salmonella 是藥品中最嚴格的「絕對不可檢出」微生物：USP ⟨1111⟩ 對所有給藥途徑的藥品都要求 Salmonella absent in 10 g。這是唯一一個在所有類別產品中都不能存在的指定微生物。
blocks.en: Salmonella is the strictest "must be absent" organism in drug products: USP ⟨1111⟩ requires Salmonella absent in 10 g for drug products of all routes of administration. It is the only specified microorganism that must be absent from every product category.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：天然來源的原料（如植物萃取物、動物來源的賦形劑）是 Salmonella 汙染的高風險來源。建議對這類原料進行 100% 的 Salmonella 測試，不接受跳批檢驗。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: Naturally derived materials (such as plant extracts and animal-derived excipients) are a high-risk source of Salmonella contamination. We recommend 100% Salmonella testing of such materials, with no skip-lot testing.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Salmonella 測試使用 0.1 mL 的 TSB 接種到 10 mL 的 RV 培養基（1:100 稀釋），而不是用更多？這個稀釋比例有什麼科學依據？
blocks.en: Why does the Salmonella test inoculate 0.1 mL of TSB into 10 mL of RV medium (a 1:100 dilution) rather than using more? What is the scientific basis for this dilution ratio?

blocks.zh: 你的 XLD 平板上出現了紅色菌落但沒有黑色中心。這可能是 Salmonella 嗎？還有哪些細菌可能產生類似的菌落形態？
blocks.en: Your XLD plate shows red colonies without black centers. Could this be Salmonella? Which other bacteria could produce a similar colony appearance?

blocks.zh: 一批草本膠囊原料的 Salmonella 測試呈陽性。作為 CDMO，你的應急處理流程應該包含哪些步驟？
blocks.en: A batch of herbal capsule raw material tests positive for Salmonella. As a CDMO, what steps should your emergency response process include?

blocks.zh: 2.2 Pseudomonas aeruginosa — 綠膿桿菌測試
blocks.en: 2.2 Pseudomonas aeruginosa Test

blocks.zh: P. aeruginosa 測試的流程精簡但有力：
blocks.en: The P. aeruginosa test flow is streamlined but effective:

blocks.zh: 非選擇性增菌（TSB） → 直接劃線到選擇性平板（Cetrimide Agar）
blocks.en: Non-selective enrichment (TSB) → streak directly onto a selective plate (Cetrimide Agar)

blocks.zh: 注意這裡沒有「選擇性液體增菌」這一步 — 從 TSB 直接到固體平板。流程比 Salmonella 和 E. coli 簡潔。
blocks.en: Note that there is no "selective liquid enrichment" step here: the flow goes straight from TSB to a solid plate. It is simpler than the Salmonella and E. coli flows.

blocks.zh: Cetrimide Agar 的選擇性原理：Cetrimide（十六烷基三甲基溴化銨）是一種季銨鹽類陽離子界面活性劑。它能破壞大多數細菌的細胞膜，但 P. aeruginosa 天生對它有抗性。這就是選擇性的來源。
blocks.en: Selectivity principle of Cetrimide Agar: Cetrimide (cetyltrimethylammonium bromide) is a quaternary ammonium cationic surfactant. It disrupts the cell membranes of most bacteria, but P. aeruginosa is naturally resistant to it. This is the source of the selectivity.

blocks.zh: 經皮貼片的特殊處理：USP 特別提到了 transdermal patches 的處理方式 — 需要通過無菌濾膜過濾。這是因為貼片不是一般的固體或液體劑型，需要特殊的萃取方式才能檢測其中的微生物。
blocks.en: Special handling of transdermal patches: USP specifically addresses how to handle transdermal patches: they must be filtered through a sterile membrane filter. Patches are neither an ordinary solid nor a liquid dosage form, so a special extraction method is needed to detect the microorganisms in them.

blocks.zh: 化學防禦戰場：
blocks.en: A chemical battlefield:

blocks.zh: Cetrimide Agar 就像一個佈滿化學武器的戰場。大多數士兵（一般細菌）踏上去就會中毒倒下。但 P. aeruginosa 像是穿了化學防護衣的特種兵 — 它天生對這種「化學武器」免疫，所以能在戰場上自在行走。如果你在這個戰場上看到有人活著走動，那幾乎可以確定是這個特種兵。
blocks.en: Cetrimide Agar is like a battlefield strewn with chemical weapons. Most soldiers (ordinary bacteria) are poisoned and fall as soon as they step onto it. P. aeruginosa, however, is like a special-forces soldier in a chemical protection suit: naturally immune to this "chemical weapon", it walks freely across the battlefield. If you see someone alive and moving around on this battlefield, it is almost certainly this special-forces soldier.

blocks.zh: P. aeruginosa 在 CDMO 環境中的重要性：
blocks.en: Importance of P. aeruginosa in the CDMO environment:

blocks.zh: P. aeruginosa 是製藥用水系統中最常見的「問題微生物」之一 — 它能在低營養環境中生存並形成生物膜
blocks.en: P. aeruginosa is one of the most common "problem microorganisms" in pharmaceutical water systems; it survives in low-nutrient environments and forms biofilms

blocks.zh: 對於外用製劑（乳膏、凝膠、洗劑）和眼用製劑，P. aeruginosa 是特別要求檢測的對象（USP ⟨1111⟩）
blocks.en: For topical preparations (creams, gels, lotions) and ophthalmic preparations, P. aeruginosa is a specifically required test organism (USP ⟨1111⟩)

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 充填線上，純化水系統的 P. aeruginosa 汙染可能影響多個客戶的產品批次
blocks.en: On a CDMO filling line, P. aeruginosa contamination of the purified water system can affect product batches for multiple clients

blocks.zh: P. aeruginosa 在 Cetrimide Agar 上的典型特徵：菌落通常產生綠色素（pyocyanin）或黃綠色螢光素（fluorescein），在 UV 燈下觀察更明顯。
blocks.en: Typical features of P. aeruginosa on Cetrimide Agar: Colonies usually produce a green pigment (pyocyanin) or yellow-green fluorescein, which is more obvious under UV light.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 P. aeruginosa 測試不需要像 E. coli 或 Salmonella 那樣有「選擇性液體增菌」的步驟？Cetrimide Agar 的選擇性足夠嗎？
blocks.en: Why does the P. aeruginosa test not need a "selective liquid enrichment" step as the E. coli or Salmonella tests do? Is the selectivity of Cetrimide Agar sufficient?

blocks.zh: 你的 CDMO 生產線用水系統監測中頻繁檢出 P. aeruginosa。這對 ⟨62⟩ 測試結果可能產生什麼影響？你會採取什麼糾正措施？
blocks.en: P. aeruginosa is frequently detected in the water system monitoring of your CDMO production line. How might this affect ⟨62⟩ test results, and what corrective actions would you take?

blocks.zh: 2.3 Staphylococcus aureus — 金黃色葡萄球菌測試
blocks.en: 2.3 Staphylococcus aureus Test

blocks.zh: Mannitol Salt Agar（MSA）的雙重選擇機制：
blocks.en: Dual selection mechanism of Mannitol Salt Agar (MSA):

blocks.zh: 高鹽選擇性（7.5% NaCl）：大多數細菌無法在如此高的鹽濃度下生長，但 Staphylococci 天生耐鹽。這就篩掉了絕大部分其他細菌。
blocks.en: High-salt selectivity (7.5% NaCl): Most bacteria cannot grow at such a high salt concentration, but Staphylococci are naturally salt-tolerant. This screens out the vast majority of other bacteria.

blocks.zh: Mannitol 發酵指示：MSA 含有甘露醇（Mannitol）和酚紅指示劑。S. aureus 能發酵甘露醇產酸，使培養基從紅色變為黃色。所以你會看到「黃色菌落 + 黃色環」的經典反應。
blocks.en: Mannitol fermentation indicator: MSA contains mannitol and the phenol red indicator. S. aureus ferments mannitol to acid, turning the medium from red to yellow. You therefore see the classic reaction of "yellow colonies + yellow zone".

blocks.zh: 注意：其他葡萄球菌（如 S. epidermidis）也能在 MSA 上生長（因為耐鹽），但通常不發酵甘露醇 — 菌落呈白色或粉紅色，周圍沒有黃色環。這就是指示性（Indicative）的價值。
blocks.en: Note: Other staphylococci (such as S. epidermidis) can also grow on MSA (because they are salt-tolerant), but they usually do not ferment mannitol. Their colonies are white or pink with no yellow zone around them. This is the value of an indicative reaction.

blocks.zh: 鹽湖裡的特殊居民：
blocks.en: Special residents of a salt lake:

blocks.zh: MSA 就像一個高鹽度的鹹水湖。一般的淡水魚（普通細菌）根本無法生存。只有耐鹽的特殊魚種（葡萄球菌）能在裡面游泳。而在這些耐鹽魚中，S. aureus 有一個獨特的習慣 — 牠吃了湖裡的甘露醇之後，會把水染成黃色（酸性代謝產物）。所以，如果你看到鹹水湖裡有一條魚，而且牠游過的地方都變成黃色，那幾乎可以確定是 S. aureus。
blocks.en: MSA is like a hypersaline lake. Ordinary freshwater fish (common bacteria) cannot survive in it at all; only special salt-tolerant fish (staphylococci) can swim there. Among these salt-tolerant fish, S. aureus has a distinctive habit: after it eats the mannitol in the lake, it dyes the water yellow (acidic metabolites). So if you see a fish in the salt lake and the water turns yellow wherever it swims, it is almost certainly S. aureus.

blocks.zh: S. aureus 與 P. aeruginosa 測試流程幾乎一模一樣：兩者都是 TSB 非選擇性增菌 → 直接劃線到選擇性平板。差別只在於平板類型。這兩個測試可以並行進行，節省時間和資源。
blocks.en: The S. aureus and P. aeruginosa test flows are almost identical: both use non-selective TSB enrichment followed by direct streaking onto a selective plate. The only difference is the plate type. The two tests can be run in parallel to save time and resources.

blocks.zh: 經皮貼片的特殊處理：與 P. aeruginosa 測試一樣，S. aureus 測試也特別提到經皮貼片需要濾膜法處理。
blocks.en: Special handling of transdermal patches: As with the P. aeruginosa test, the S. aureus test also specifically notes that transdermal patches must be handled by the membrane filtration method.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：
blocks.en: CDMO practice:

blocks.zh: S. aureus 對於外用製劑（topical products）和經皮製劑（transdermal products）特別重要
blocks.en: S. aureus is particularly important for topical products and transdermal products

blocks.zh: 人員衛生是 S. aureus 汙染的主要來源 — 它是人類皮膚和鼻腔的常見共生菌
blocks.en: Personnel hygiene is the main source of S. aureus contamination, as it is a common commensal of human skin and nasal passages

blocks.zh: 生產環境監測（EM）中如果頻繁檢出 Staphylococci，要特別注意人員操作規範和更衣程序
blocks.en: If Staphylococci are frequently detected in environmental monitoring (EM) of the production area, pay particular attention to personnel practices and gowning procedures

blocks.zh: MSA 平板上長出白色菌落但沒有黃色環。這意味著什麼？產品合格嗎？你需要進一步做什麼測試？
blocks.en: White colonies grow on an MSA plate but there is no yellow zone. What does this mean? Does the product pass? What further tests do you need to perform?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 S. aureus 對人類健康的威脅與其作為皮膚共生菌的身份之間存在矛盾？這對 CDMO 的人員管理有什麼啟示？
blocks.en: Why is there a contradiction between the threat S. aureus poses to human health and its status as a skin commensal? What does this suggest for personnel management at a CDMO?

blocks.zh: 如果你的 MSA 平板在抑制性測試中未能完全抑制 E. coli（預期應被抑制），可能的原因是什麼？
blocks.en: If your MSA plate fails to fully inhibit E. coli in the inhibitory (suitability) test (where it is expected to be inhibited), what are the possible causes?

blocks.zh: 2.4 Clostridia — 梭菌測試
blocks.en: 2.4 Clostridia Test

blocks.zh: Clostridia 測試是 ⟨62⟩ 中設計最獨特的測試，具有三大特殊之處：
blocks.en: The Clostridia test is the most distinctively designed test in ⟨62⟩, with three special features:

blocks.zh: 雙份樣品（加熱 vs 不加熱）：
blocks.en: Duplicate samples (heated vs. unheated):

blocks.zh: 加熱份（80°C, 10 min）：殺死所有營養體細胞（vegetative cells），只留下耐熱的孢子（spores）。如果加熱份長出厭氧菌，幾乎可以確定是產孢的 Clostridia。
blocks.en: Heated portion (80°C, 10 min): Kills all vegetative cells, leaving only heat-resistant spores. If anaerobes grow from the heated portion, they are almost certainly spore-forming Clostridia.

blocks.zh: 未加熱份：檢測包括營養體在內的所有 Clostridia。
blocks.en: Unheated portion: Detects all Clostridia, including vegetative cells.

blocks.zh: 兩者比較可以判斷汙染是孢子形式還是營養體形式，對根因分析很重要。
blocks.en: Comparing the two shows whether the contamination is in spore form or vegetative form, which is important for root cause analysis.

blocks.zh: 全程厭氧培養：Clostridia 是嚴格厭氧菌 — 氧氣對它們有毒。所有培養步驟都必須在厭氧條件下進行。
blocks.en: Anaerobic incubation throughout: Clostridia are strict anaerobes, and oxygen is toxic to them. All incubation steps must be performed under anaerobic conditions.

blocks.zh: Catalase 陰性確認：這是區分 Clostridia 和其他厭氧菌的快速測試。Clostridia 不產生 catalase 酶，所以加 H2O2 不會冒泡。
blocks.en: Confirmation by negative catalase: This is a rapid test to distinguish Clostridia from other anaerobes. Clostridia do not produce the catalase enzyme, so adding H2O2 produces no bubbles.

blocks.zh: 火災現場的生還者搜索：
blocks.en: Searching for survivors at a fire scene:

blocks.zh: 想像你要在一棟建築物中搜索特殊的「耐火居民」（Clostridia 孢子）。你把建築物分成兩半：一半放火燒（80°C 加熱），一半不燒。
blocks.en: Imagine you need to search a building for special "fire-resistant residents" (Clostridia spores). You split the building in two: one half is set on fire (80°C heating) and the other half is not.

blocks.zh: 在燒過的那一半中，如果還有人活著，那一定是穿了防火衣的人（= 孢子）
blocks.en: In the half that was burned, anyone still alive must be wearing a fireproof suit (= spores)

blocks.zh: 在沒燒的那一半中，你可以看到所有居民（包括沒穿防火衣的普通人 = 營養體）
blocks.en: In the half that was not burned, you can see all the residents, including ordinary people without fireproof suits (= vegetative cells)

blocks.zh: 然後你把存活者帶到一個沒有氧氣的房間（厭氧培養）— 只有真正的「厭氧居民」才能在這裡生存。最後做一個 catalase 測試，就像查身份證一樣確認身份。
blocks.en: You then take the survivors to a room with no oxygen (anaerobic incubation), where only true "anaerobic residents" can live. Finally, a catalase test confirms their identity, much like checking an ID card.

blocks.zh: 厭氧培養設備是關鍵瓶頸：Clostridia 測試需要厭氧工作站（anaerobic workstation）或厭氧罐（anaerobic jar）搭配氣體產生包（GasPak）。許多小型 QC 實驗室可能沒有這些設備，需要外包給具備能力的實驗室。
blocks.en: Anaerobic incubation equipment is the key bottleneck: The Clostridia test requires an anaerobic workstation or an anaerobic jar with a gas-generating pack (GasPak). Many small QC laboratories may not have this equipment and need to outsource to a qualified laboratory.

blocks.zh: 為什麼是 2 g 而非 1 g？因為樣品要分成兩份（加熱和不加熱），每份至少需要能提供 1 g 等效量的產品進行測試。所以起始量至少 2 g。
blocks.en: Why 2 g rather than 1 g? Because the sample is split into two portions (heated and unheated), and each portion must supply at least a 1 g equivalent of product for testing. The starting quantity is therefore at least 2 g.

blocks.zh: Clostridia 測試主要針對口服和直腸給藥的產品
blocks.en: The Clostridia test mainly applies to products for oral and rectal administration

blocks.zh: 天然來源原料（如澱粉、明膠）是 Clostridia 孢子汙染的常見來源
blocks.en: Naturally derived materials (such as starch and gelatin) are a common source of Clostridia spore contamination

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 不具備厭氧培養設備，考慮與外部實驗室建立合約測試安排
blocks.en: If your CDMO lacks anaerobic incubation equipment, consider setting up a contract testing arrangement with an external laboratory

blocks.zh: 如果加熱份長出 Clostridia 但未加熱份沒有長出，你會如何解釋這個結果？這在科學上可能嗎？
blocks.en: If Clostridia grow from the heated portion but not from the unheated portion, how would you explain this result? Is this scientifically possible?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Clostridia 測試使用 Columbia Agar 而非更具選擇性的培養基？Columbia Agar 的功能是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does the Clostridia test use Columbia Agar rather than a more selective medium? What is the function of Columbia Agar?

blocks.zh: Catalase 測試的原理是什麼？為什麼它能幫助區分 Clostridia 和其他厭氧菌？
blocks.en: What is the principle of the catalase test? Why does it help distinguish Clostridia from other anaerobes?

blocks.zh: 2.5 Candida albicans — 白色念珠菌測試
blocks.en: 2.5 Candida albicans Test

blocks.zh: C. albicans 測試的獨特之處 — 培養時間是關鍵：
blocks.en: What is unique about the C. albicans test: incubation time is critical:

blocks.zh: 增菌培養 3-5 天：這是所有 ⟨62⟩ 測試中最長的增菌時間。原因很簡單 — 真菌的生長速度遠比細菌慢。細菌通常 18-24 小時就能形成可見菌落，但酵母菌需要數天。
blocks.en: Enrichment incubation of 3-5 days: This is the longest enrichment time among all ⟨62⟩ tests. The reason is simple: fungi grow much more slowly than bacteria. Bacteria usually form visible colonies in 18-24 hours, whereas yeasts need several days.

blocks.zh: Sabouraud Dextrose 培養基（SDB/SDA）：低 pH（5.6）是其核心特徵。大多數細菌在 pH 5.6 下生長不良，但真菌喜歡微酸性環境。加上高糖含量（Dextrose），為真菌提供充足的碳源。
blocks.en: Sabouraud Dextrose medium (SDB/SDA): The low pH (5.6) is its core feature. Most bacteria grow poorly at pH 5.6, whereas fungi favor a slightly acidic environment. The high sugar content (dextrose) also gives fungi ample carbon.

blocks.zh: 白色菌落 = 初步指示：C. albicans 在 SDA 上形成白色到乳白色的光滑菌落。但許多其他酵母菌也長出類似菌落，所以確認鑑定不可少。
blocks.en: White colonies = preliminary indication: C. albicans forms smooth, white to cream-colored colonies on SDA. However, many other yeasts form similar colonies, so confirmatory identification is essential.

blocks.zh: 慢跑者的專屬跑道：
blocks.en: A special track for the slow runner:

blocks.zh: 如果細菌是短跑選手（18-24 小時衝刺到終點），那 C. albicans 就是馬拉松選手 — 需要 3-5 天才能跑到終點。你必須為這個慢跑者設計一條特殊的跑道（SDB/SDA, pH 5.6）— 酸性環境阻止了短跑選手搶道，讓馬拉松選手有足夠的時間和空間完成比賽。如果你在 24 小時就吹哨結束比賽，這個馬拉松選手可能還在半路上，你就會以為沒有選手參賽（假陰性）。
blocks.en: If bacteria are sprinters (dashing to the finish in 18-24 hours), C. albicans is a marathon runner who needs 3-5 days to reach the finish line. You must design a special track for this slow runner (SDB/SDA, pH 5.6): the acidic environment keeps the sprinters from crowding the lane and gives the marathon runner enough time and space to finish the race. If you blow the whistle and end the race at 24 hours, the marathon runner may still be halfway along, and you will think no runner entered (a false negative).

blocks.zh: C. albicans 測試的適用範圍：根據 USP ⟨1111⟩，C. albicans 測試主要適用於陰道給藥產品（vaginal preparations）。不是所有產品都需要做這項測試 — 務必根據產品的給藥途徑確認是否需要。
blocks.en: Scope of the C. albicans test: According to USP ⟨1111⟩, the C. albicans test mainly applies to vaginal preparations. Not every product needs this test, so always confirm from the route of administration whether it is required.

blocks.zh: 確認鑑定方法：
blocks.en: Confirmatory identification methods:

blocks.zh: Germ tube test：將疑似菌落接種到血清中，37°C 培養 2-3 小時。C. albicans 會形成芽管（germ tubes），這是最經典、最快速的確認方法。
blocks.en: Germ tube test: Inoculate the suspect colony into serum and incubate at 37°C for 2-3 hours. C. albicans forms germ tubes, which is the most classic and fastest confirmation method.

blocks.zh: CHROMagar Candida：顯色培養基，C. albicans 在上面形成綠色菌落，其他 Candida species 形成不同顏色。
blocks.en: CHROMagar Candida: A chromogenic medium on which C. albicans forms green colonies, while other Candida species form different colors.

blocks.zh: MALDI-TOF MS / API 20C AUX：更精確但需要更多設備。
blocks.en: MALDI-TOF MS / API 20C AUX: More accurate but requires more equipment.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：如果你的 CDMO 承接陰道用藥的充填業務，C. albicans 測試是必做項目。建議在方法轉移時特別注意培養時間的控制 — 不要因為趕放行時間而縮短增菌培養期。
blocks.en: CDMO practice: If your CDMO takes on filling of vaginal products, the C. albicans test is mandatory. During method transfer, pay particular attention to controlling incubation time, and do not shorten the enrichment period to meet the release schedule.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 C. albicans 的增菌培養溫度是 30-35°C 而非其最適生長溫度 37°C？這個選擇有什麼考量？
blocks.en: Why is the C. albicans enrichment incubation temperature 30-35°C rather than its optimum growth temperature of 37°C? What considerations lie behind this choice?

blocks.zh: 你的 SDA 平板上長出了乳白色菌落，但 germ tube test 為陰性。這意味著什麼？產品合格嗎？
blocks.en: Cream-colored colonies grow on your SDA plate, but the germ tube test is negative. What does this mean? Does the product pass?

blocks.zh: 比較 ⟨62⟩ 中所有六種測試的增菌培養時間。為什麼它們的時間差異如此大？這反映了什麼微生物學原理？
blocks.en: Compare the enrichment incubation times of all six tests in ⟨62⟩. Why do they differ so much? What microbiological principle does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 2.6 Comprehensive Test Comparison — 六大測試綜合比較
blocks.en: 2.6 Comprehensive Test Comparison: The Six Tests

blocks.zh: 以下為本教材根據 USP ⟨62⟩ 原文整理的綜合比較表，涵蓋所有六項測試的關鍵參數：
blocks.en: The following comprehensive comparison table, compiled for this course from the original text of USP ⟨62⟩, covers the key parameters of all six tests:

blocks.zh: 從表格中可以歸納出 USP ⟨62⟩ 的設計邏輯：
blocks.en: The design logic of USP ⟨62⟩ that can be drawn from the table:

blocks.zh: 樣品量與風險成正比：Salmonella（10 g）> Clostridia（2 g）> 其他（1 g）。風險越高，檢測量越大。
blocks.en: Sample quantity is proportional to risk: Salmonella (10 g) > Clostridia (2 g) > others (1 g). The higher the risk, the larger the test quantity.

blocks.zh: 培養時間與生長速度反相關：細菌（18-48 hr）< 真菌（3-5 天）。生長越慢，培養時間越長。
blocks.en: Incubation time is inversely related to growth rate: bacteria (18-48 hr) < fungi (3-5 days). The slower the growth, the longer the incubation.

blocks.zh: 選擇性機制多樣：膽鹽（BTGNB）、高溫（E. coli）、極端 pH（Salmonella via RV）、化學抗性（P. aeruginosa via Cetrimide）、高鹽（S. aureus via MSA）、厭氧（Clostridia）、低 pH（C. albicans via SDB/SDA）。
blocks.en: Diverse selection mechanisms: bile salts (BTGNB), elevated temperature (E. coli), extreme pH (Salmonella via RV), chemical resistance (P. aeruginosa via Cetrimide), high salt (S. aureus via MSA), anaerobic conditions (Clostridia), low pH (C. albicans via SDB/SDA).

blocks.zh: CDMO 的測試規劃效率：理解這張總表後，你可以最大化實驗室效率：
blocks.en: Test planning efficiency at a CDMO: Once you understand this summary table, you can maximize laboratory efficiency:

blocks.zh: P. aeruginosa 和 S. aureus 可以同時從 TSB 增菌液取樣劃線到不同平板
blocks.en: P. aeruginosa and S. aureus can be sampled at the same time from the TSB enrichment and streaked onto different plates

blocks.zh: E. coli 測試的非選擇性增菌步驟（TSB, 30-35°C）也可以與 P. aeruginosa / S. aureus 共用
blocks.en: The non-selective enrichment step of the E. coli test (TSB, 30-35°C) can also be shared with P. aeruginosa / S. aureus

blocks.zh: Clostridia 和 C. albicans 因為需要特殊條件（厭氧 / 長時間培養），通常獨立進行
blocks.en: Clostridia and C. albicans usually run independently because they need special conditions (anaerobic / prolonged incubation)

blocks.zh: Salmonella 的 10 g 樣品量要求需要獨立取樣
blocks.en: The 10 g sample quantity required for Salmonella calls for separate sampling

blocks.zh: 總結來看，一個完整的 ⟨62⟩ 測試大約需要 7-9 個工作天才能完成所有項目（以 C. albicans 的 3-5 天增菌 + 後續平板培養為最長路徑）。這對放行時間有重大影響 — 也是為什麼快速微生物方法（RMM）在產業中越來越受歡迎。
blocks.en: In total, a complete set of ⟨62⟩ tests takes about 7-9 working days to finish all items (the longest path being the 3-5 day enrichment for C. albicans plus the subsequent plate incubation). This has a major impact on release time, and it is also why rapid microbiological methods (RMM) are increasingly popular in the industry.

blocks.zh: 如果你是 CDMO 的 QC 主管，要為一個新的口服固體劑型建立 ⟨62⟩ 測試方案，根據 USP ⟨1111⟩，你需要做哪些測試？哪些不需要？
blocks.en: As QC head at a CDMO, you need to set up a ⟨62⟩ test program for a new oral solid dosage form. According to USP ⟨1111⟩, which tests do you need to perform, and which do you not?

blocks.zh: 設計一個時間甘特圖（Gantt Chart），展示所有 6 項 ⟨62⟩ 測試的並行安排，以最短的總時間完成所有測試。
blocks.en: Design a Gantt chart showing the parallel scheduling of all 6 ⟨62⟩ tests so that all testing is completed in the shortest total time.

blocks.zh: 比較使用傳統藥典方法與快速微生物方法（如 PCR、ATP 生物冷光法）進行 ⟨62⟩ 測試的優缺點。CDMO 在導入 RMM 時應考慮哪些驗證要求？
blocks.en: Compare the advantages and disadvantages of performing ⟨62⟩ tests with traditional pharmacopoeial methods versus rapid microbiological methods (such as PCR or ATP bioluminescence). What validation requirements should a CDMO consider when implementing RMM?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Salmonella 測試要求最大樣品量（10 g），使用 RV 增菌培養基（滅菌溫度 ≤ 115°C），XLD 平板上紅色 ± 黑心菌落為指示反應
blocks.en: The Salmonella test requires the largest sample quantity (10 g), uses RV enrichment broth (sterilization temperature ≤ 115°C), and the indicator reaction is red ± black-centered colonies on XLD plates

blocks.zh: P. aeruginosa 測試使用 Cetrimide Agar（季銨鹽選擇性），經皮貼片需濾膜法處理，是用水系統監測的關鍵指標菌
blocks.en: The P. aeruginosa test uses Cetrimide Agar (quaternary ammonium selectivity); transdermal patches require membrane filtration; it is a key indicator organism for water system monitoring

blocks.zh: S. aureus 測試使用 Mannitol Salt Agar（7.5% NaCl + 甘露醇發酵指示），黃色菌落 + 黃色環為典型反應，人員衛生是主要汙染來源
blocks.en: The S. aureus test uses Mannitol Salt Agar (7.5% NaCl + mannitol fermentation indicator); yellow colonies + yellow zone is the typical reaction; personnel hygiene is the main source of contamination

blocks.zh: Clostridia 測試設計最獨特：雙份樣品（加熱/不加熱）、全程厭氧培養、catalase 陰性確認三重特徵
blocks.en: The Clostridia test has the most distinctive design, with three features: duplicate samples (heated/unheated), anaerobic incubation throughout, and confirmation by negative catalase

blocks.zh: C. albicans 測試增菌時間最長（3-5 天），使用低 pH Sabouraud 培養基，主要適用於陰道給藥產品
blocks.en: The C. albicans test has the longest enrichment time (3-5 days), uses low-pH Sabouraud medium, and mainly applies to vaginal products

blocks.zh: 完整 ⟨62⟩ 測試約需 7-9 個工作天，C. albicans 培養為關鍵路徑，快速微生物方法（RMM）可顯著縮短時間
blocks.en: A complete set of ⟨62⟩ tests takes about 7-9 working days; C. albicans incubation is the critical path, and rapid microbiological methods (RMM) can significantly shorten the time

blocks.zh: CDMO 連結：根據產品給藥途徑確定必測項目、測試並行化策略、設備投資（厭氧培養、MALDI-TOF）、用水系統管控是營運核心
blocks.en: CDMO linkage: determining the required tests by route of administration, parallelizing the tests, equipment investment (anaerobic incubation, MALDI-TOF), and water system control are the core of operations
